whatThisIs: The BUILDER's own count of the nine completeness counters, computed with the repository's own contract functions over this family's field map, its byte-derived glyph readings and its participant-instructions.md.
whatThisIsNot: A verdict. This lane does not verify its own packets, and PASS_COMPLETE additionally requires a hash-bound RASTER_PASS from the central raster workflow.

howEachWasMeasured.knownRequiredFieldsMissing: classifyBlank over every blank in the field map
howEachWasMeasured.requiredFactsNotCollected: every required-before-filing blank searched for by label, id and identity in participant-instructions.md
howEachWasMeasured.unclassifiedBlanks: classifyBlank over every blank in the field map
howEachWasMeasured.incompleteRows: rowKeyOf over every field; this packet declares no repeating table, so no row group was formed and none could be partly written
howEachWasMeasured.requiredOptionsMissing: classifyBlank over every blank in the field map
howEachWasMeasured.requiredComponentsMissing: the committed registry's own packetSet for each of the five routes, compared against the components this build produced
howEachWasMeasured.invisibleWrites: per artifact and per page, from the byte-derived glyph readings; a component that declares writes and added no glyph to its page is counted
howEachWasMeasured.protectedWrites: classifyField over every write's printed label
howEachWasMeasured.visualDefects: the byte-derived count of added glyphs landing outside a measured write box
